# Royal Inn Tartus (فندق رويال إن طرطوس)

> Royal Inn is a 4-star hotel on the Sea Corniche in Tartus (Tartous), Syria. 65 rooms and suites, each with a balcony facing the Mediterranean. Electricity 24 hours. Guests book directly with the hotel on its website or by WhatsApp. Official website: https://royalinntartus.com

Last updated: 2026-11-19

## Key facts
- Name: Royal Inn (Arabic: فندق رويال إن). Also written Royal Inn Hotel Tartus / Royal Inn Tartous.
- Type: 4-star hotel
- Location: Sea Corniche (الكورنيش البحري), Tartus, Syria
- Rooms: 65 rooms and suites, all with balcony and sea view
- Facilities: restaurant, lobby cafe, wedding and events hall, free guest parking, 24-hour reception, 24-hour electricity
- Nearby: Tartus old town, boats to Arwad Island, Amrit

## Rates per night (US dollars, tax included)
- Standard Room, one guest: $90
- Standard Room, two guests: $100
- Triple Room (three single beds): $130
- Junior Suite (up to 2 guests): $130
- Royal Suite (up to 2 guests): $150
- Royal Suite with its connecting room (up to 4 guests): $250 (the connecting room is charged at the Standard Room rate for two)
- No extra beds: larger parties book more rooms; the booking form suggests room combinations with prices
- Breakfast: optional, $10 per person

## Booking and payment
- Book direct: https://royalinntartus.com/en/contact (English), https://royalinntartus.com/ar/contact (Arabic) or https://royalinntartus.com/tr/contact (Turkish). The form shows the total and availability.
- WhatsApp and phone: +963 998 730 730 (https://wa.me/963998730730)
- Email: res@royalinn.org
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=5941287336967691339
- Tripadvisor: https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g304152-d15360933-Reviews-Royal_Inn-Tartus_Tartus_Governorate.html
- Payment: a deposit by money transfer inside Syria confirms the booking (the hotel sends the details on WhatsApp); the balance is paid at the hotel in cash, in US dollars. No credit card is needed.
- Cancellation: free up to 48 hours before arrival.
- International booking sites (Booking.com, Expedia) do not list hotels in Syria at the time of writing, so booking is direct.

## Arabic summary (ملخص بالعربية)
فندق رويال إن فندق 4 نجوم على الكورنيش البحري في طرطوس، سوريا. 65 غرفة وجناحاً، جميعها بشرفة مطلّة على البحر، وكهرباء على مدار 24 ساعة. الأسعار لليلة شاملة الضريبة: الغرفة القياسية 90 دولاراً لضيف واحد و100 دولار لضيفين، والغرفة الثلاثية 130 دولاراً. الفطور 10 دولارات للشخص. يُثبَّت الحجز بدفعة مقدّمة عبر حوالة داخل سوريا والباقي يُدفع في الفندق. الإلغاء مجاني حتى 48 ساعة قبل الوصول. الحجز مباشرة من الموقع أو عبر واتساب +963 998 730 730.
